verdict.rationale: Docs confirm subagents can be spawned by a main agent for parallel, isolated subtasks with specialized instructions, and sessions support forking to branch conversation histories — enabling some multi-agent orchestration within one workflow. However, there is no documented support for higher-level 'crew' orchestration patterns (e.g., agent-to-agent handoff protocols, role-based team coordination, or built-in orchestration primitives beyond spawning subagents), and no independent/hands-on evidence of complex multi-agent workflows in production. Missing for 10: documented handoff mechanisms between peer agents, native crew/team orchestration APIs, and hands-on validation of multi-agent workflows at scale.
